    Proper intervals of full-support string graph components #

    The position selected by a one-sided full-support component traverses the entire shorter word with constant slope. When the other word is strictly longer, the selected interval has an explicit unused position on at least one of its two sides.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.BoundQuiver.StringWord.Word.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent.HasFullOutputSupport.inputPosition_endpointSlope {k Q : Type u} [Field k] [Quiver Q] {R : RelationFamily k Q} {C D : Word R} (component : C.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent D) (hfull : component.HasFullOutputSupport) :
    (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index + length R D ∨ (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index + length R D

    The source positions selected over the two target endpoints differ by the target word's length.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.BoundQuiver.StringWord.Word.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent.HasFullOutputSupport.inputPosition_properInterval {k Q : Type u} [Field k] [Quiver Q] {R : RelationFamily k Q} {C D : Word R} (component : C.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent D) (hfull : component.HasFullOutputSupport) (hlength : length R D < length R C) :
    (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index + length R D ∧ (0 < (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index ∨ (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index < length R C) ∨ (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index + length R D ∧ (0 < (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index ∨ (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index < length R C)

    If the source word is strictly longer, a full-target-support component occupies a proper source interval, with the unused side recorded together with its orientation.

    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.BoundQuiver.StringWord.Word.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent.HasFullOutputSupport.exists_outgoingAtTarget_of_forward_of_lt {k Q : Type u} [Field k] [Quiver Q] {R : RelationFamily k Q} {C D : Word R} (component : C.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent D) (hfull : component.HasFullOutputSupport) (hforward : (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index + length R D) (hlt : (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index < length R C) :
    ∃ (y : Q) (j : C.PositionAt y) (a : D.target ⟶ y), j.index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index + 1 ∧ C.ArrowStep a (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition) j

    At the right end of an increasing full-target-support interval, an extra source-word edge must point out of the interval.

    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.BoundQuiver.StringWord.Word.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent.HasFullOutputSupport.exists_outgoingBoundary_of_length_lt {k Q : Type u} [Field k] [Quiver Q] {R : RelationFamily k Q} {C D : Word R} (component : C.BoundaryFreeMorphismCoefficientComponent D) (hfull : component.HasFullOutputSupport) (hlength : length R D < length R C) :
    (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index + length R D ∧ ((∃ (x : Q) (j : C.PositionAt x) (a : D.source ⟶ x), j.index + 1 = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index ∧ C.ArrowStep a (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition) j) ∨ ∃ (y : Q) (j : C.PositionAt y) (a : D.target ⟶ y), j.index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index + 1 ∧ C.ArrowStep a (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition) j) ∨ (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index + length R D ∧ ((∃ (x : Q) (j : C.PositionAt x) (a : D.target ⟶ x), j.index + 1 = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition).index ∧ C.ArrowStep a (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.targetPosition) j) ∨ ∃ (y : Q) (j : C.PositionAt y) (a : D.source ⟶ y), j.index = (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition).index + 1 ∧ C.ArrowStep a (component.inputPosition ⋯ D.sourcePosition) j)
